description: Search the Glyfiq medical and health icon library by keyword or medical term (for example 'cardiology', 'MRI', 'fracture', 'stethoscope'). Uses synonyms, fuzzy matching and full-text search. Results are sorted by relevance, best match first, and the limit parameter (1 to 50, default 20) controls how many top-ranked matches are returned. Returns metadata only (name, tags, is_free), never SVG code. Both free and PRO icons are listed; PRO icons have is_free: false. Call this first, then call get_icon_svg with an exact name from the results. If nothing matches, try a broader or alternative term, or call list_tags for popular tags.

license_key.description: Glyfiq PRO license key. Usually configured once in the connector URL; pass here only to override.

limit.description: Max results to return. Use 5–10 for quick lookups, 20 for comprehensive searches, 50 for full library scans.

query.description: Medical term or keyword to search for, e.g. 'heart', 'MRI', 'fracture', 'bladder'. Use terms from list_tags for best results.

name: search_icons
title: Search medical icons
